<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sa_pattern"><sa_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><ci_type>cmdb_ci_appl_generic</ci_type><cpattern_type>2</cpattern_type><description/><directory>false</directory><enforce_proc_classy>false</enforce_proc_classy><invoke_per_account>false</invoke_per_account><metadata_id>007df198c30d7210982a7d0ed401317e</metadata_id><name>Proxmox VE</name><ndl>library {
	name = "Proxmox VE"
	id = "007df198c30d7210982a7d0ed401317e"
	description = "Proxmox VE"
	step {
		name = "Is this Proxmox?"
		runcmd_to_var {
			cmd = "pveversion"
			execution_mode = "DEFAULT"
			var_names = "pveversion"
			parsing_strategy = delimited_parsing {
				selected_positions = 1
			}
			if_not_found_do = terminate {}
			cache_flag = 0
		}
	}
	step {
		name = "Get PVE version number"
		set_attr {
			"pveversion_number"
			eval {"javascript: var rtrn = '';
var parts = ${pveversion}.split(\"/\");
var version = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : null;
rtrn = version;"}
		}
	}
	step {
		name = "Create KVM host"
		set_attr {
			"cmdb_ci_kvm[*].name"
			concat {
				"Proxmox_VE_"
				get_attr {"pveversion_number"}
				"_KVM@"
				get_attr {"cmdb_ci_linux_server[*].name"}
			}
		}
	}
	step {

	step {
		name = "Set details XML"
		set_attr {
			"cmdb_ci_kvm[*].details_xml"
			eval {"javascript: var rtrn=\"\";
var resultObject = {
  capabilities: {
    cpu: JSON.parse(${qemu_cpu_capabilities}),
    machines: JSON.parse(${qemu_machines_capabilities}),
    migration: JSON.parse(${qemu_migration_capabilities})
  }
};

// rtrn = JSON.stringify(resultObject, null, 2);

var indent = '    ';
var level1 = indent;
var level2 = indent + indent;
var level3 = indent + indent + indent;

var xml = '';
var capabilities = resultObject.capabilities;
var section;
var key;
var i;

xml += '<capabilities>\\n';

for (section in capabilities) {
  if (!capabilities.hasOwnProperty(section)) {
    continue;
  }

  xml += level1 + '<' + section + '>\\n';

  if (capabilities[section] instanceof Array) {

    for (i = 0; i < capabilities[section].length; i++) {
      xml += level2 + '<item>\\n';

      for (key in capabilities[section][i]) {
        if (!capabilities[section][i].hasOwnProperty(key)) {
          continue;
        }

        xml += level3 +
               '<' + key + '>' +
               String(capabilities[section][i][key]) +
               '</' + key + '>\\n';
      }

      xml += level2 + '</item>\\n';
    }

  } else {

    for (key in capabilities[section]) {
      if (!capabilities[section].hasOwnProperty(key)) {
        continue;
      }

      xml += level2 +
             '<' + key + '>' +
             String(capabilities[section][key]) +
             '</' + key + '>\\n';
    }
  }

  xml += level1 + '</' + section + '>\\n';
}

xml += '</capabilities>';

rtrn = xml;"}
		}

// Inputs
var jsonText = ${qemu_vms_config_json};
var wantedName = ${qemu_vms[].name};

// Parse JSON
var data = JSON.parse(jsonText);

// Find object by name
var vm = null;
var i;
for (i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (data[i].name == wantedName) {
        vm = data[i];
        break;
    }
}

// Create XML if found
var xml = '';

if (vm !== null) {
    xml = '<config>\\n';

    var key;
    for (key in vm) {
        if (vm.hasOwnProperty(key)) {

            // Escape XML values
            var value = String(vm[key]);
            value = value.replace(/&/g, '&amp;');
            value = value.replace(/</g, '&lt;');
            value = value.replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
            value = value.replace(/\"/g, '&quot;');
            value = value.replace(/'/g, '&apos;');

            xml += '    <' + key + '>';
            xml += value;
            xml += '</' + key + '>\\n';
        }
    }

    xml += '</config>';
}

// Return XML
rtrn = xml;
